Notes: Figures for 2025 and 2026 are estimates. * These are the actual figures at the moment of the inauguration of the new government of the Republic of Slovenia on 04 June 2026. The new Slovenian government is committed to a credible implementation of the commitments jointly agreed at the Hague Summit. Therefore, the current financial projections from 2026 onwards will be reviewed and reprogrammed. A credible national plan to exceed 2% of GDP on core expenditure in the current year, and reach 3.5% of GDP by 2035, will be indicated after the Ankara Summit and finalised with concrete steps in the following months. This note applies to all following tables displaying this symbol.
